method: Actual local browser controls on the public single-operation application; current PNG also checked through its authenticated API

checks.check: Fresh public app has an empty result and no list of past runs
Generation submitted via browser button, output and parameters visible
Original PNG bytes match current image SHA256
Screenshot contains only controls and current result; no paths or session URL
Same bookmark authenticates after a real server restart
Restarted server exposes an empty current result and old PNG returns 404

limitations: Smoke timing is a functional observation, not an additional controlled quality benchmark.
Full standalone report browser layout is not verified; DOM mechanics and embedded image bytes are checked separately.
